name: Rover Park (safe haven)
objective: Pressurised rover parked at the edge of the boxwork unit. Start and end of the EVA.
finding: Curiosity crossed into the boxwork unit on sol 4534 (7 May 2025).

name: Altadena
objective: Sample bedrock at the edge of the unit as a baseline.
finding: Curiosity drilled "Altadena" at the edge of the boxwork on 8 June 2025.

name: First ridge
objective: Examine a ridge crest and its central fracture.
finding: Curiosity confirmed the dark lines along ridge tops are fractures. Pea-size nodules sit on ridge walls and in hollows, not near the central fractures.

name: Monte Grande hollow
objective: Sample bedrock on a hollow floor.
finding: Curiosity drilled "Valle de la Luna" here in October 2025. X-ray analysis found carbonate minerals.

name: Nevado Sajama ridge
objective: Sample the ridge top about 10 m away and 2 m higher than the hollow.
finding: Curiosity drilled "Nevado Sajama" on sol 4718 (13 Nov 2025). X-ray analysis found clay minerals.

name: Ridge overlook
objective: Panorama and scouting of ridges and hollows to the east.
finding: Curiosity drove north-east along this wide ridge in February 2026 for a view of targets to the east.
